sloka: अधीतस्य च तप्तस्य कर्मणः सुकृतस्य च ।षष्ठं भजति भागं तु प्रजा धर्मेण पालयन् ।। ७.७४.३० ॥
transliteration: adhītasya ca taptasya karmaṇaḥ sukṛtasya ca ।ṣaṣṭhaṁ bhajati bhāgaṁ tu prajā dharmeṇa pālayan ।। 7.74.30 ॥

translations.english: A king who protects his subjects righteously obtains a sixth share of the merit from their Vedic studies, penance, and good deeds.
